tracesTo: SOW: User Interactions - Content Creation & Engagement

stories.title: Add Comments to Feed Moments
stories.goal: add comments to any moment in the feed to participate in discussions
stories.benefit: I can share my reactions, opinions, and engage in conversations about league activity
acceptanceCriteria: Comment input field appears below each moment in feed with clear call-to-action
User can write multi-line text comments with basic formatting preserved
Submitting comment immediately displays it below the moment with author attribution
Comment shows author's name, role (Manager/Fan), team affiliation, and timestamp
Character limit enforced with counter display (e.g., 2000 character maximum)

stories.title: Reply to Comments with Threading
stories.goal: reply directly to specific comments to maintain conversation context
stories.benefit: I can have focused sub-conversations and it's clear what each reply is responding to
acceptanceCriteria: Reply button appears on each comment enabling threaded responses
Replies appear indented below parent comment with visual connection indicator
Threading supports at least 2 levels deep (comment → reply → nested reply)
Reply interface clearly shows which comment user is responding to
Threaded view can be collapsed/expanded for long conversation trees

stories.title: Edit Own Comments
stories.goal: edit my comments after posting to correct typos or clarify my thoughts
stories.benefit: I can fix mistakes without deleting and reposting, maintaining conversation continuity
acceptanceCriteria: Edit button appears on user's own comments with edit icon or text
Clicking edit opens inline editor pre-filled with current comment text
User can modify text and save changes or cancel to revert
Edited comments display 'edited' indicator with timestamp of last edit
Edit history is not displayed publicly but may be logged for moderation

stories.title: Delete Own Comments
stories.goal: delete my comments if I change my mind or posted by mistake
stories.benefit: I have control over my own content and can remove comments I regret
acceptanceCriteria: Delete button appears on user's own comments with confirmation prompt
Deleted comments are immediately removed from view for all users
If deleted comment has replies, either preserve structure with '[deleted]' placeholder or remove thread
User receives confirmation message after successful deletion
Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone by user (admin may retain for moderation)

stories.title: Add Emoji Reactions to Moments
stories.goal: quickly react to moments with emoji without writing full comments
stories.benefit: I can express sentiment and engage with content using minimal effort
acceptanceCriteria: Reaction picker button appears on each moment with emoji icon
Clicking picker displays panel with common emoji options (like, laugh, sad, fire, thinking, etc.)
User can select emoji to add reaction which displays immediately below moment
Reactions show emoji with count and hovering reveals who reacted
User can only add one reaction of each emoji type per moment

stories.title: Add Emoji Reactions to Comments
stories.goal: react to individual comments with emoji for lightweight engagement
stories.benefit: I can show agreement or sentiment without writing reply comments
acceptanceCriteria: Reaction picker button appears on each comment similar to moment reactions
Same emoji picker interface and behavior as moment reactions
Comment reactions display inline below or beside comment text
Reactions contribute to comment engagement scoring for visibility
User can toggle off their own reaction by clicking same emoji again

stories.title: Remove Own Reactions
stories.goal: remove emoji reactions I added if my sentiment changes
stories.benefit: I can update my reactions to reflect current feelings without permanent commitment
acceptanceCriteria: User can click on emoji they previously added to remove their reaction
Reaction count decrements immediately and emoji removed if count reaches zero
Visual indicator shows which reactions current user has added (e.g., highlighted border)
Removing reaction does not trigger notification or create audit trail visible to others
User can remove and re-add same reaction multiple times without restriction

stories.title: Display Comment Counts on Moments
stories.goal: see how many comments each moment has before expanding discussion
stories.benefit: I can identify active discussions and decide which moments to engage with
acceptanceCriteria: Comment count badge displays prominently on each moment card
Count includes all top-level comments and replies in total
Count updates in real-time as new comments are added
Clicking comment count scrolls to or expands comment section
Zero-comment moments show 'Be the first to comment' prompt

stories.title: Display Reaction Summary on Moments
stories.goal: see what reactions a moment has received at a glance
stories.benefit: I can gauge community sentiment without opening full detail
acceptanceCriteria: Reaction summary displays top 3-5 most used emoji with counts
Reactions show in order of popularity (most used first)
Total unique reactors count displayed alongside emoji breakdown
Clicking reaction summary shows full list of who reacted with what emoji
Empty reactions section hidden or shows 'Be the first to react' prompt

stories.title: Track Engagement for Feed Bumping
stories.goal: track all comment and reaction activity to enable engagement-based feed sorting
stories.benefit: active discussions receive visibility and moments don't get buried too quickly
acceptanceCriteria: System records timestamp for every comment and reaction added
Moment's 'last activity' timestamp updates whenever engagement occurs
Engagement metrics (comment count, reaction count, recent activity) stored for sorting algorithm
System distinguishes between initial post time and last engagement time
Engagement data persists across sessions for historical analysis

stories.title: Notification of Replies to My Comments
stories.goal: be notified when someone replies to my comments
stories.benefit: I can continue conversations and don't miss direct responses to my engagement
acceptanceCriteria: User receives notification when another member replies to their comment
Notification includes snippet of reply text and link to moment/comment
Notifications distinguish between direct replies and other activity on same moment
User can control notification preferences for reply alerts
Notification marks as read when user views the replied comment

stories.title: Admin Moderation of Comments
stories.goal: remove inappropriate or problematic comments from feed
stories.benefit: I can maintain healthy community environment and enforce league standards
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can delete any comment regardless of author with moderation UI
Deleted comments show '[removed by admin]' placeholder or disappear entirely per admin preference
Admin action logged in moderation history with admin identity and timestamp
Admin can optionally provide removal reason visible to comment author
Bulk moderation tools available for removing multiple comments in one action
